relationships.subject: spinal dorsal horn neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicate that CGRPSPFp neurons receive monosynaptic inputs from the spinal dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: CGRP SPFp neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of CGRPSPFp neurons is sufficient to generate threat memory, independent of changes in sensory pain responses

key_findings: CGRP neurons in the SPFp receive monosynaptic spinal dorsal horn input, respond to nociceptive stimuli, and their silencing reduces pain responses.
Optogenetic activation of CGRP SPFp neurons induces threat memory without altering sensory pain thresholds.
